title: Rooms Revocations Get — payload
description: An administrator of a room reads the revocation list its host holds and enforces for it.

presentation.description: Must confer the `admin` action at this room's scope. The list names withdrawn parties on `open` and `attributed` rooms, which is the room's administration and not a member's business.

Response.title: Rooms Revocations Get — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/revocations/get. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/revocations/get/0.1#response. The list the host holds, exactly as the room signed it, or nothing when it holds none.

list.description: The list the host holds, as the room signed it. Absent when the host holds none. A reader MUST verify it as a host does — the room's own key, this room — before relying on it, and MUST NOT adopt it in place of a list it holds at a higher sequence.

inForceAt.description: When the host began enforcing `list`. Present with it.
